issue.title: PX4 SITL MAVSDK test seg faulting
issue.body:
I saw [seemingly random PX4 mavsdk tests in the PX4 CI seg fault](https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/pull/25261#issuecomment-3586520441) and went into a rabbit hole to find out why.

After managing to run the tests against a simple SIH simulation instance https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/compare/main...maetugr/sih-ci I was able to reproduce seg faults every now and then locally.
I then removed this line from Catch2: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/main/test/mavsdk_tests/catch2/catch.hpp#L8027 which prevents it from capturing the seg fault and screwing up debugging.
Then figuring out all the commands to run manually such that the python invocator can't capture the seg fault but I can do that with gdb:
```
DONT_RUN=1 make px4_sitl mavsdk_tests
PX4_SIM_MODEL=sihsim_quadx PX4_SIM_SPEED_FACTOR=10 build/px4_sitl_default/bin/px4 build/px4_sitl_default/etc -s etc/init.d-posix/rcS -t test_data -d
gdb --args build/px4_sitl_default/mavsdk_tests/mavsdk_tests --url udpin://0.0.0.0:14540 --speed-factor 10 "Takeoff and hold position"
```

